stories.sourceText: Mira lists Draft and Publish as all tasks for Orion during June. Mira Draft duration is 2 hours during June for Orion. Mira Publish duration is 3 hours during June for Orion. Mira states Draft prerequisites are none for Orion during June. Mira states Publish prerequisites are Draft for Orion during June. Mira states schedule basis is earliest starts from project start with independent resources for Orion during June. Mira requests critical path calculation for Orion during June.
